recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,884.50 (+0.25%) and the Sensex at 84,328.59 (+0.46%); Bank Nifty moved -0.26%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +0.20%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.26%, small caps (Smallcap 250) +0.59%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹5,843 cr and DIIs net buyers of ₹5,631 cr (provisional, NSE).
IT led the sectors (+3.66%), while FMCG lagged (-0.94%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Action Construction (+8.79%); biggest faller was Bank of Maharashtra (-4.57%). Breadth: 253 advances vs 245 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.25% and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.
The rupee is at 92.44 per dollar, Brent at $92.32 (-2.42%) and gold at $3,654 (+3.36%).
